title: Goebel Hummel Coffee Break HUM 409 Club Special Edition No. 8 W Germany w/ Box
conditionDescription: Excellent - no chips, cracks, crazing or repairs found; paint bright. Original box included, with shelf wear and tape.
descriptionText:
M.I. Hummel "Coffee Break" figurine, HUM 409 - the exclusive Goebel Collectors' Club Special Edition No. 8. A boy in a feathered hat leaning back on a grassy mound taking a rest, with his jug, bundle and hat beside him. About 4 1/4 inches tall.

The underside carries the blue "Exclusive Special Edition No. 8 For Members of the Goebel Collectors' Club" backstamp with the Goebel W. Germany bee mark (TMK-6 era), the incised 409 model number, and the painter's mark dated 85.

Includes the original Goebel Collectors' Club box with the styrofoam insert and the 470 / Western Germany end label.

Condition: Excellent - no chips, cracks, crazing or repairs found, and the paint is bright. The box shows shelf wear, tape and edge rubbing as pictured. Please review all photos - they are of the actual figurine you will receive.
